title: Scheduled meeting link opens in the call window
description:
Source flow: CONF-QA-001

Choosing Desktop application on the go.rocket.chat page opens the meeting in a separate call window while the main window keeps showing the workspace.
postconditions:
- Screenshot of the call window at step 4.
- Screenshot of the main window at step 5 and step 7.
steps_actions:
1. "In the main Rocket.Chat window, click any channel in the workspace's left room list so a normal room is open. Note the room name shown at the top of the room."
2. "In the browser, open `test-links.html`, fill in the workspace host and a valid scheduled-meeting alias, then click the link labelled `go.rocket.chat scheduled meeting link`."
3. "Click the blue `Desktop application` button in the middle of the page. If the browser shows a prompt asking to open Rocket.Chat, click its open/allow button."
4. "Look for a new, separate window (it has its own title bar and taskbar/dock entry, next to the main Rocket.Chat window)."
5. "Switch back to the main Rocket.Chat window."
6. "In the call window, leave the meeting with the meeting's own hang-up control."
7. "Close the call window, then click another channel in the main window."
steps_data:
1. "Any channel
Agent: Open a channel and record its name."
2. "Workspace host, meeting alias
Agent: Open the generated go.rocket.chat URL."
3. "Agent: Click `Desktop application`; accept the protocol prompt."
4. "Agent: Find the new call window and capture it."
5. "Agent: Capture the main window."
6. "Agent: Hang up in the call window."
7. "Agent: Close call window; open another room."
steps_results:
1. "A normal room with its message list is shown; the workspace sidebar with the room list is visible on the left."
2. "A white go.rocket.chat page opens with the Rocket.Chat logo, the text `Where do you want to open this link?`, the workspace link in blue, and two blue buttons: `Desktop application` and `Web application`."
3. "Rocket.Chat comes to the front."
4. "A separate call window shows the meeting: a `Chat` panel on the left with an `Add people` button (`Personen hinzufügen` in German) and the meeting video area on the right. No login screen and no ""not authorized"" message appears in it."
5. "The main window still shows the room from step 1 with the workspace sidebar and room list. It does NOT show the meeting, the `Chat` / `Add people` panel, or `You left the meeting`."
6. "`You left the meeting` (`Sie haben das Meeting verlassen`) appears only inside the call window. The main window is unchanged."
7. "The call window closes. The main window navigates normally."

title: Conference link clicked inside a room opens in the call window
description:
Source flow: CONF-QA-002

Clicking a conference address posted in a room opens the meeting in the call window and the main window stays on the room.
postconditions:
- Screenshot of the posted message and of the main window after the click.
- Screenshot of the call window.
steps_actions:
1. "In `test-links.html`, fill in the workspace host and a valid scheduled-meeting alias, then copy the text in the `Conference address to paste in a room` box."
2. "In the main Rocket.Chat window, open any channel from the left room list, click the message composer at the bottom, paste the address and press Enter."
3. "Click the link in the message you just sent."
4. "Switch back to the main window."
5. "Optional: if the room has a Pexip call message, open its call information and click the `URL:` address instead."
steps_data:
1. "Workspace host, meeting alias
Agent: Copy the generated address."
2. "Copied address
Agent: Post the address as a message."
3. "Agent: Click the posted link."
4. "Agent: Capture the main window."
5. "Existing call
Agent: Click the call-info URL."
steps_results:
1. "The copied text looks like `https://<workspace-host>/conference/<alias>?scheduled=true`."
2. "The message appears in the room with the address shown as a link."
3. "A separate call window opens with the `Chat` panel (`Add people` button) on the left and the meeting video area on the right."
4. "The main window shows the same room with the message list and the workspace sidebar. At most a very brief flash; it does not stay on the meeting screen."
5. "Same result as steps 3-4."

title: Reload and restart keep the workspace after a meeting
description:
Source flow: CONF-QA-003

Reload, force reload and an app restart after joining a meeting all show the workspace, never the meeting screen.
postconditions: - Screenshot of the main window after steps 2, 3 and 5.
steps_actions:
1. "Run CONF-QA-001 up to step 5, keep the call window open, and note the room shown in the main window."
2. "In the main window, open the `View` menu in the menu bar (Windows/Linux: press Alt if the menu bar is hidden) and click `Reload`."
3. "Open the `View` menu again and click `Force reload`."
4. "Right-click the workspace's icon in the left server list (or its tab at the top) and click `Force reload`."
5. "Quit Rocket.Chat completely (Windows: right-click the tray icon, `Quit`; macOS: `Rocket.Chat` menu, `Quit Rocket.Chat`), then start it again."
steps_data:
1. "Agent: Complete CONF-QA-001 steps 1-5."
2. "Agent: Trigger View > Reload."
3. "Agent: Trigger View > Force reload."
4. "Agent: Use the workspace context menu."
5. "Agent: Quit and relaunch."
steps_results:
1. "Main window shows a room."
2. "The workspace reloads and shows the same room, not the meeting."
3. "The workspace reloads and shows a normal page, not the meeting."
4. "Same as step 3."
5. "The workspace opens on a normal page with the room list. The meeting screen does not appear."

title: A workspace stuck on the meeting screen recovers after updating
description:
Source flow: CONF-QA-004

After installing this build over a stuck installation, the workspace opens on a normal page without being removed and re-added.
postconditions:
- Screenshot of the stuck state (step 1) and of the first launch after
  updating (step 3).
steps_actions:
1. "On a machine with the previous Rocket.Chat Desktop version, get stuck: open a scheduled meeting link with `Desktop application` (as in CONF-QA-001), confirm the main window shows the meeting screen, then quit Rocket.Chat. Skip this step if the machine is already stuck."
2. "Install this branch's build over the existing installation. Do not remove the workspace."
3. "Start Rocket.Chat."
steps_data:
1. "Older build
Agent: Reproduce the stuck state on the old build."
2. "Branch build
Agent: Install over the old build."
3. "Agent: Launch and capture."
steps_results:
1. "Main window shows the meeting screen before quitting."
2. "Installation completes."
3. "The workspace opens on its home page or a room, with the room list visible. The meeting screen does not appear."

title: Scheduled meeting link opens the call window when the app is closed
description:
Source flow: CONF-QA-005

With Rocket.Chat fully closed, the link starts the app and opens the meeting in the call window exactly once.
postconditions: - Screenshot of both windows after step 3.
steps_actions:
1. "Quit Rocket.Chat completely (Windows: right-click the tray icon, `Quit`; macOS: `Rocket.Chat` menu, `Quit Rocket.Chat`). Confirm no Rocket.Chat icon remains in the tray/dock."
2. "In `test-links.html`, click `go.rocket.chat scheduled meeting link`, then click the blue `Desktop application` button and accept the browser's open prompt."
3. "Wait for the main window to finish loading the workspace (up to about 30 seconds)."
steps_data:
1. "Agent: Quit the app."
2. "Workspace host, meeting alias
Agent: Open the link and hand off to the app."
3. "Agent: Count call windows; capture both windows."
steps_results:
1. "Rocket.Chat is not running."
2. "Rocket.Chat starts."
3. "One separate call window opens with the meeting (`Chat` panel with `Add people` on the left). The main window shows the workspace with its room list."

title: Scheduled meeting link opens in the browser when video calls inside app is off
description:
Source flow: CONF-QA-006

With Video calls inside app switched off, the meeting opens in the default browser and the main window keeps the workspace.
postconditions: - Screenshot of the browser tab and of the main window.
steps_actions:
1. "In the left vertical server list, click the three-dots/kebab button near the bottom edge below the server buttons, click `Settings`, click the `Voice & Video` tab near the top, and switch `Video calls inside app` off."
2. "Run CONF-QA-001 steps 1-3."
3. "Switch back to the main Rocket.Chat window."
4. "Switch `Video calls inside app` back on."
steps_data:
1. "Agent: Disable the setting."
2. "Workspace host, meeting alias
Agent: Open the link."
3. "Agent: Capture the main window."
4. "Agent: Restore the setting."
steps_results:
1. "The toggle is off."
2. "The meeting opens in the default web browser. No separate Rocket.Chat call window opens."
3. "The main window still shows the room with the room list."
4. "The toggle is on."
